subject: Re: FSQ repro status: FID parity, 99% codebook utilization
body:
Team,

Decision from today's review: FSQ is adopted for tokenizer v2. The 99% vs 71% codebook utilization result plus FID parity settles it — we drop the VQ training machinery from the stack.

Scope call: panoptic segmentation moves to Q3 and rides on the budgeted comparison sweeps; depth and colorization parity is enough for the adoption decision. Carmen, please file the high-res dimensionality question as the first Q3 experiment.

Leilani owns the migration plan for downstream teams — draft by Jul 3, and we hold current VQ checkpoints frozen for rollback through end of Q3.

Nice work everyone, this was a clean result.

Zofia
